name: Karyn Chin
occupation: Teton County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Karyn Chin is a Teton County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Wes Gardner, who is serving through December 31, 2026. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she finished third in the three-seat race with 5,329 votes, behind Ali Dunford and Luther Propst.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Dunford, Propst and Chin elected to Teton County Commission
